name: io.github.inviti8/obol
title: Obol
description: A disposable Algorand wallet for an AI agent, so it can pay for x402 resources without a human provisioning anything.

environmentVariables.name: OBOL_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Which chain to use: 'testnet' (the default) or 'mainnet'. Mainnet spends real money.

environmentVariables.name: OBOL_DATA_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where the vault key and session ledger live. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Obol on Windows and ~/.obol elsewhere. Point this at a NEW directory only if you intend a new wallet: the seed here is the only way back to money already on chain.
